facts.value: Applications must be submitted via an online system provided and operated by uni-assist e.V.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The online application allows for paperless submission and is conducted through the central online portal for Master's programs.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Applicants can upload required documents, such as CV and certificates, digitally via the upload function.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Examinations completed at a university will generally only be recognized if they were completed no more than five calendar years before the start of the Master's program.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: An application for credit transfer must be submitted with the application. Evidence of all previously completed services at a university must be included.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Only services that are included in the submitted application or performance record can be recognized. Academic achievements from a Bachelor's degree cannot be credited towards the Master's degree.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The ranking of applicants is based on a value that consists of 60% from the grade of the required degree or the provisional average grade and 40% from the grade of the study exposé.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Applicants with foreign degrees must provide proof of German language skills at the level of the Central Intermediate Examination (C1 level).
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Every provisionally admitted applicant must take and pass the DSH-2 examination by the start of the lecture period.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: If the Bachelor's certificate is not yet available, applicants must submit additional documents by July 15.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The semester contribution for the Master's program is approximately €350.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: A final admission occurs after submission of the Bachelor's certificate within a specific deadline. If the Bachelor's requirements are not met, provisional admission will be revoked.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: A subsequent application for recognition will not be permitted.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
